result.title: TACT-Bench: Testing Adaptive Conversational Threats against Tool-Use Agents
result.comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/IliaHashemiRad/TACTBench
result.summary: The growing autonomy of AI agents in using external tools and making decisions has created an urgent need for comprehensive safety benchmarks. Existing benchmarks test compromised tool channels or adaptive multi-turn attacks, though they may not capture the unique capabilities of policy-governed tool-use agents, which must resist unauthorized requests without abandoning the legitimate work embedded in the same interaction. To fill this gap, we introduce TACT-Bench, a stateful benchmark built around scenario-specific stories, personas, manipulation tactics, and response-adaptive escalation. Each adversarial task targets an action explicitly prohibited by the policy provided to the assistant, while the policy remains hidden from the attacking user. TACT pairs each adversarial task with at least one benign counterpart, and its adversarial tasks retain authorized ground-truth actions when a compliant resolution remains available. We define these base tasks as TACT-Base. We additionally introduce TACT-TrustPrime, which places an independent benign task before an unrelated attack in the same conversation. We also propose Paired Selective Trustworthiness (PST), which combines explicit safe refusal with demonstrated capability on matched benign tasks, to analyze an agent's overcautiousness and practicality. Averaged across 6 different models as assistants, TACT-Base raises Attack-Induced Failure Rate (AFR) by 17.53% over four compatible attack baselines, and TACT-TrustPrime raises it by a further 17.01%. The two evaluated defense methods reduce AFR by only 8.35%--9.41% on average and do not consistently improve PST, underscoring the need for stronger policy-enforcement methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TACT-Bench，一个面向工具使用智能体的有状态安全基准，用场景故事、人设与响应自适应升级构造多轮对抗任务，并配套良性对照任务与 PST 指标，衡量安全拒答与正常完成能力的平衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 材料聚焦对话式对抗攻击与策略合规，其「有状态」指会话历史而非视觉证据或推理状态，也未涉及 latent 表示、视觉通路、动态计算或停止决策，缺少与 LVR 主线可核查的具体线索，故排除。
